interfaces.name: horn
interfaces.what: the +x output disc: Ø16.0000 x 3.0010 (centre x 13.0000, so the disc spans x 11.4990..14.5000 and its outer face IS the mesh's x maximum, 14.5000), carrying 4 x Ø1.6000 x 6.0000 tapped holes at x 11.5000, (y, z) = (0, +6), (0, -6), (+6, 0), (-6, 0) — a Ø12.0000 bolt circle. Ø1.6 is cecad.fasteners' M2 tap drill. MEASURED ABSENCE, kept: the real servo's centre hub is NOT in this mesh — the axis probe reads solid material from x -14.5 to +14.5 — so the hub diameter is CANNOT DETERMINE here while every measured bracket on this robot carries a Ø5-6 centre bore.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's xl330.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders (least-squares cylinder fit per smooth patch; the fit residual and angular cover of every feature quoted here are in the artifact), frozen 2026-09-02 by tools/measure_mesh_features.py into out/laneT/features/xl330.json (lane T); the body frame is the MJCF geom placement of that mesh at zero pose, body 'trunk_base + 14 others', world pos [per placement] mm, quat (wxyz) [per placement], from ce-assemblies/microduck/current/placements.json

interfaces.name: idler
interfaces.what: the -x disc, geometrically identical to 'horn': Ø16.0000 x 3.0000 at centre x -13.0000 (spanning x -14.5000..-11.5000) with the same 4 x Ø1.6000 x 6.0000 taps on a Ø12.0000 bolt circle at x -11.5000. WHICH FACE IS DRIVEN IS NOT IN THE MESH: the two are mirror-identical, so 'horn' and 'idler' are an assembly choice, and every joint row that uses one says which it took.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's xl330.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders (least-squares cylinder fit per smooth patch; the fit residual and angular cover of every feature quoted here are in the artifact), frozen 2026-09-02 by tools/measure_mesh_features.py into out/laneT/features/xl330.json (lane T); the body frame is the MJCF geom placement of that mesh at zero pose, body 'trunk_base + 14 others', world pos [per placement] mm, quat (wxyz) [per placement], from ce-assemblies/microduck/current/placements.json

interfaces.name: case_screws
interfaces.what: 4 x Ø2.0000 through-holes running the full 23.0000 mm across the case (axis x, centred at x 0.0000) at (y, z) = (+8, +7.5), (-8, +7.5), (+8, -22.5), (-8, -22.5) — a 16.0000 x 30.0000 mm rectangle. These are the case mounting holes every bracket on this robot bolts to. Case bbox 29.0000 x 20.0000 x 34.0000 mm.
